sources: docs/proposals/vrm-author-cli/README.md §9 (delivery binding, ingredient preservation, missing-source and unknown-rights treatment)

inputClasses: file path with or without a sidecar
invariants: returns the ingredient graph with binding, signature and trust reported separately (notApplicable / absent / pass / pending)
trust is pending until a trust policy is configured through VRM_AUTHOR_TRUST_POLICY
an unknown asset, asset and file together, and a nonexistent file are rejected
contradictory duplicate declarations and incompatible ingredient terms are reported as conflicts
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass

fixtures.path: synthetic:project with an imported PNG and a resolved declaration inspected in all three forms
fixtures.note: testProvenanceInspectLedgerAssetAndFileForms: ingredient kinds and ordering, binding notApplicable/absent/pass

fixtures.path: synthetic:unknown asset, asset+file together, nonexistent file
synthetic:ledger form before any trust policy is configured
fixtures.note: testProvenanceInspectLedgerAssetAndFileForms: trust pending, then pass once VRM_AUTHOR_TRUST_POLICY names the signer

mutants.description: testProvenanceInspectLedgerAssetAndFileForms: an unknown asset, both selectors together and a missing file must be rejected; trust must stay pending without a policy.
testIncompatibleIngredientTermsAndContradictoryDuplicatesConflict: stricter ingredient terms and contradictory duplicate declarations must surface as INGREDIENT_* and LEDGER_CONTRADICTION conflicts.
testVerifyTamperedBindingFailsBindingOnly: a one-bit change to the bound file must fail binding while signature and trust still pass, so the separation inspect reports is real.

A report envelope claiming every ProvenancePackTests test passed (executed 23, failed 0, exit 0) whose oracleHashes name a Tests/VRMAuthorKitTests/Provenance/ProvenancePackTests.swift other than the pinned one. The runner's report-acceptance path must refuse it before any assertion runs.

visual.applicabilityRecord: provenance inspect is a read over the ingredient ledger and sidecar bindings and never renders a frame, so no view, motion or landmark can change its result. Recorded by the acceptance author (claude-fable-5-1); the independent reviewer confirms or overturns this in reviewReceipt.

evidencePolicy.heldOutPolicy: Every fixture is synthetic and built in-process by the suite (or a git-tracked file pinned by sha256); no development-corpus asset is consumed, so no held-out family applies.

canonicalArtifacts: resultHash: sha256 of the canonical result manifest
